accountIntro: Keep your medicine requirements, quotations and documents together in one private account.
passwordHelp: Use at least 4 characters. Spaces are allowed.
verifyIntro: Confirm that this is your email address to securely access your RFQs and quotations.
invalidLink: This link is invalid or expired. Request a new link and open the complete URL from your email.
verified: Your email has been verified. Your RFQs and quotations are now available in your account.
resetSent: If an active account matches this email, we will send a password reset link.
resetComplete: Your password has been reset. Sign in with your new password.
emailUnavailable: Email delivery is not available yet. You can save drafts while our team helps you complete verification.
resetEmailUnavailable: Password reset email delivery is not configured yet. Please contact our support team for assistance.
invalidCredentials: Incorrect email or password. If you do not have an account yet, click Create account below.
accountExists: An account already exists for this email. Sign in or use the password reset option.
tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
checkFields: Check the form fields and try again.
unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
dashboardIntro: Manage your sourcing enquiries and follow each quotation from one place.
verificationRequired: Verify your email before viewing RFQs and quotations or submitting a draft. Your profile and saved drafts are already available.
verificationSent: A verification link has been sent to your email.
loadFailed: We could not load your account information. Refresh and try again.
draftHelp: Save your requirements here and submit them as an RFQ when ready. Using your quote list replaces the current lines.
saveFailed: Your changes could not be confirmed. Refresh the current state before trying again.
submissionFailed: Submission could not be confirmed. Use Check / retry submission to safely check the same draft; it will not create a second RFQ.
emptyDrafts: No saved requirements yet. Create a requirement or use products from your quote list.
emptyRfqs: No RFQs have been submitted for this account yet.
emptyQuotations: Your issued quotations will appear here when our team sends them.
emptyRevisions: Your quotation revision and follow-up requests will appear here.
emptyHistory: Your account activity will appear here.
pdfUnavailable: The PDF is not available for download yet. Please try again or contact our team.
revisionNotes: What would you like us to review?
revisionSent: Your revision request has been recorded for our team.
revisionFailed: We could not confirm this revision request. Check your requests before sending it again.
quoteDecisionHelp: To accept or decline a current quotation, use the private quotation link sent to your email.
revisionsHelp: Your quotation revision requests and other quotation follow-ups are listed here.
passwordChangeFailed: The password change could not be confirmed. Check your current password and try again.
